questions.stem: Where does the energy for active transport come from?

options.text: From the kinetic energy of the particles themselves
From ATP produced by cellular respiration in mitochondria
From the concentration gradient between two areas

questions.explanation: Active transport requires energy from ATP, which is produced during cellular respiration in the mitochondria. This is why cells that carry out a lot of active transport, such as root hair cells, contain many mitochondria.
